lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Morning, Hyunju! You're early today. Do you have a busy day?
lines.ko: 좋은 아침이에요, 현주 씨! 오늘 일찍 왔네요. 오늘 바빠요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Yes, I'll be busy writing a report. I have to send it to my manager by tomorrow.
lines.ko: 네, 보고서 쓰느라 바쁠 거예요. 내일까지 매니저님께 보내야 해요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Oh, a report due tomorrow? That's tight! What's the report about?
lines.ko: 아, 내일 마감인 보고서요? 빠듯하네요! 무슨 보고서예요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: It's about next year's sales plan.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Next year's sales plan? That's a big one! Do you need any help with the numbers?
lines.ko: 내년 판매 계획이요? 큰 거네요! 숫자 쪽으로 도와줄까요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I always have trouble with numbers, so I need your help. When I finish the report, could you please check the numbers in it?
lines.ko: 제가 늘 숫자에 약해서 도움이 필요해요. 보고서 다 쓰면 숫자 좀 확인해 주실 수 있어요?

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Of course! Just send it to me when it's ready. What time do you think you'll finish?
lines.ko: 그럼요! 다 되면 보내 줘요. 몇 시쯤 끝날 것 같아요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like to finish it by three p.m. Then I'll send it to you by email.
lines.ko: 오후 3시까지 끝내고 싶어요. 그다음에 이메일로 보내 드릴게요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Three p.m. is perfect. I'll check it before I leave. By the way, did you have breakfast? You look a little tired.
lines.ko: 3시면 딱 좋아요. 퇴근 전에 확인해 줄게요. 그런데 아침은 먹었어요? 조금 피곤해 보여요.

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I didn't have breakfast. I was in a hurry. Let's have a cup of coffee and some snacks.
lines.ko: 아니요, 못 먹었어요. 급하게 나왔거든요. 커피랑 간식 좀 먹어요.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Good idea! I have some muffins and cookies. Which do you want, a muffin or a cookie?
lines.ko: 좋아요! 머핀이랑 쿠키 있어요. 머핀이랑 쿠키 중에 뭐 먹을래요?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I'd like a muffin. Thank you so much.

lines.name: Kate
lines.en: Here you go! Good luck with your report today, Hyunju. You can do it!
lines.ko: 여기요! 오늘 보고서 잘 써요, 현주 씨. 할 수 있어요!
